subject: Request: Accelerator cohort - promo credits + trial extension
messages:
From: Emma Park <emma@foundrylabs.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerator cohort — request for credits and short trial extension

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well — excited to be kicking off our Fall accelerator next week. Quick ask: several portfolio startups will be doing early infra work and model evaluation with Redwood as part of their curriculum. Two things we need help with from your side:

1) A promotional credit pool (one-time) that we can allocate across ~6 companies (average expected usage ~$1.5k each).
2) A 30-day trial extension for startups who already used credits during onboarding but need more time for evaluation and demo day prep.

We’ve attached the accelerator acceptance letter and a simple roster. If there’s an eligibility form or a promo code flow you prefer, we can adopt it. Goal is to avoid friction for the cohort — they’re doing prompt engineering coursework and running experiments that’ll drive real usage.

Can you confirm what’s possible (and any limits / required approvals)? We can commit to listing Redwood as an infrastructure partner on demo day materials.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Park
Program Director, Foundry Labs
emma@foundrylabs.io
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: Foundry_Accelerator_Acceptance.pdf (1 page; cohort roster)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@foundrylabs.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort — request for credits and short trial extension

Hi Emma — welcome and congrats on the cohort.

Thanks for the materials — looks like a good fit. Quick clarifying Qs so I route internal approvals:
- Is the $1.5k estimate per startup total consumption over 60 days, or peak monthly run-rate?
- Do any startups expect to handle regulated data or require Private deployment options?

We have a promo pool that we can typically allocate for accelerator partners; standard approach is: 6 startups x $1.5k = $9k total in credits, plus a 30-day extension for any trial accounts that are within 30 days of expiry. Exceptions beyond $10k require a manager sign-off.

I’ve looped in Aditya (partnerships lead) and Karthik (head of sales) to confirm the exact approval path. If you can reply with the usage timing and any compliance needs I’ll get this moving today.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Attachment: promo-credit-summary.csv (stub referenced)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Accelerator cohort — request for credits and short trial extension

Vanessa / Karthik — forwarding Foundry request. Notes from me:
- Cohort size = 6, expected engagement window Sep 8 - Oct 20 (6 weeks).
- No flagged regulated data in the acceptance letter.
- Marketing/value: Foundry will list Redwood as infra partner on demo day and include us in partner slide deck (worth ~40 founders / 1 regional demo day).

As stated, our promo pool cap without exec approval is $10k. This would be $9k if we go by Vanessa’s numbers. Ask: Approve a manual allocation of $9,000 in promo credits and enable 30-day trial extension for accounts that are eligible. We should also create a one-line partner code to track usage and tie to HubSpot deal FDY-ACC-2025-09.

Karthik — any objections? If green, I’ll create the promo code and route redemption instructions to Emma.

—Aditya

On Wed, Sep 3, 2025 at 09:30 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> +1 from me for $9k promo allocation.
> Please ensure we have the Foundry partner mention in their materials (recorded screenshot or slide prior to demo day).
>
> Karthik Iyer

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@foundrylabs.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort — request for credits and short trial extension

Hi Emma — good news.

We’ve approved a one-time $9,000 promo credit allocation for Foundry Labs to distribute across the cohort (recommendation: $1,500 per startup). We’ve also enabled a 30-day trial extension flow for any cohort accounts that are within 30 days of expiry on Sep 8 — Oct 8 window.

Next steps for you:
- Confirm the final roster names + emails in a reply or by updating the attached roster (Foundry_Accelerator_Acceptance.pdf).
- We’ll issue a partner promo code: FOUNDRY-FALL25. Please share redemption instructions with the cohort and ask founders to include the promo code at signup.
- For tracking, we’ve linked this to HubSpot deal FDY-ACC-2025-09 — I’ll send a short instructions doc to your inbox on how to claim credits and view usage.

Attached: promo-credit-summary.csv (internal allocation worksheet) — I’ll also drop the promo code and a short FAQ into the Drive link.

Thanks for including Redwood on demo day — looking forward to the cohort.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
